profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer @ JP Morgan | Ex-Googler
profile.jobTitle: Vice President - Senior Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a senior software engineer with 9 years of experience building big data platforms and high-scale distributed systems at JPMorgan Chase and creating tooling that prevents breaking changes from entering Google Search. Experience includes Apache Spark pipelines that process billions of rows daily, Spring Boot applications serving over 55 million customers, and setting technical direction across globally distributed teams.

positions.title: Vice President - Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized an Apache Spark batch job that processes 850 million rows, reducing the processing time by 75% from 6 hours to 1.5 hours.
- Architected the system to reduce the time to enable an advertising campaign from 2 weeks to several hours.
- Led development of effort to serve personalized advertisement campaigns to millions of customers.
- Reduced time-to-market for advertising campaigns by leading the design of a domain-speciﬁc language (DSL) that enables external systems to automate advertisement targeting across several lines of business within the ﬁrm.
- Set the technical direction for the advertising platform modernization effort across 3 teams (~20 engineers) globally, guiding execution and aligning cross-team dependencies.
- Standardized technical documentation practices across teams by introducing a system-wide documentation framework based on ADRs and RFCs, reducing miscommunication across teams and maintaining a history of architectural decisions
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Spark · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a system to prevent breaking changes from entering Google Search’s critical features, using Python, Java, gRPC, Google PubSub, and Google Protobufs.
- Designed and implemented an alerting system to notify teams of potential breaking changes entering Google Search.
- Built stakeholder dashboards to track the number of breaking changes that were prevented.
- Led the creation of the team’s onboarding process and onboarded the ﬁrst external user to the infrastructure.
- Automated the process of catching breaking changes that could affect Google Search’s Generative AI (AI Overview Section).

positions.title: Vice President - Software Engineering
positions.description:
- A lead for the ﬁrm’s Personalization and Insights Team.
- Designed, implemented, and maintained the team’s ETL Spark jobs.
- Used technologies, such as Java, Python, Scala, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Spark, and Hadoop, to build the ﬁrm’s Insights system.
- Maintained an SLO of 250 milliseconds even as we continued to scale to millions of customers.
- Built production debugging dashboards using Dynatrace and Splunk that reduced the time to identify and resolve incidents.
- Gathered requirements and prioritized features to meet clients’ and stakeholders’ expectations.

positions.title: Senior Associate - Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Selected for the ﬁrm’s initiative to automate the processing of the SBA PPP Loans, helping distribute $30 billion to small businesses during the COVID-19 pandemic.
- Led the development of multiple Scala-based Spark jobs that performed analytics and generated KPI reports from our primary application.
- Scaled the team’s application to over 55 million customers while maintaining an SLO of 250 milliseconds as we surpassed more than 425 transactions per second.
- Selected out of an estimated 30 participants for a weeklong professional program to better understand how to grow as a leader.

positions.title: Associate - Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a Java Spring Boot application from scratch that aggregated data from multiple Cassandra data stores to give customers ﬁnancial insight into their spending and investing habits.
- Scaled the application from supporting hundreds of customers to supporting millions by migrating it to the cloud.
- Created the proof of concept that was used as the basis for moving the application into a cloud environment.
- Helped create a CI/CD pipeline for the application, which reduced our deployment time to production from a few hours to approximately 30 minutes.
- Created the ﬁrst CI/CD pipeline for Spark jobs within our division at the ﬁrm; this became the standard for all CI/CD Spark job pipelines within our division.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Data Analysis Tool (Summer 2017) : Created Scala applications, used the IntelliJ IDE and Gradle as the build tool, that created statistics from a large data set stored in AWS S3 and gave those statistics to a service to be used by other users. Used Git for version control. 

Chaos Engineering Tool (Summer 2016) : Created a Scala application, using the IntelliJ IDE and SBT as the build tool, that randomly added attributes to Google Protocol Buﬀers and populated them with values, allowed users to test the robustness of their applications to non-breaking changes. Used Git for version control.

positions.description: One-on-One Tutoring With Students, Held Office Hours for Helping Students with Assignments, Grading Papers

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered at Our House Inc. Greenville, MS. Spoke out against domestic violence and mentored those younger me that were part of the Y.E.S (Youth Enrichment Services) Group in the organization. The Y.E.S Group main goal is to increase leadership skills of the youth in the surrounding areas.

- Volunteer on weekends to teach Computer Science to groups that are under-represented in the field
- Serve as a mentor to some of the students that come through the program
- Help specifically with the Illinois Institute of Technology Chapter of STARS Computing Corps
